node.label: late infantile neuronal ceroid lipofuscinosis
node.definition: A genetically heterogeneous group of neuronal ceroid lipofuscinoses (NCLs) typically characterized by onset during infancy or early childhood with decline of mental and motor capacities, epilepsy, and vision loss through retinal degeneration.
